annotations.title: Upload link for the original slip

description: A new one-time upload link for a slip handed in with accounting_record_slip whose original has not been attached yet (e.g. the first link expired). Give the link to the user. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

business_id.description: Accounting practices only: which client's books (an id from accounting_list_my_businesses). Leave out to use the books chosen at sign-in.
